description_en: Located in Omabāhāla Ṭola, Paḥkhāḥ Bāhāḥ serves as a branchbāhāḥof Viśvakarmā (Bikamā) Bāhāḥ, which is known to have been established before 1706 CE (NS 826).Thisbāhāḥis situated in Omabāhāla Ṭola. To the west of thisbāhāḥlies Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ (KAT2190), also known as Bikamā Bāhāḥ. Thisbāhāḥis a branch of Bikamā Bāhāḥ, comprising one lineage (khalaka) of the Bikamā Bāhāḥ (Locke 1985, p. 358). Various names are in use for thisbāhāḥ. It is also called Varṣacandana Vihāra. Additionally, Locke (1985, p. 358) has referred to thisbāhāḥas Khasā Chẽ Bāhāḥ and Vaṃ (Oṃ) Bāhāḥ. The Dyaḥchẽ of this bāhāḥ is constructed as a three-story structure. On the ground floor, Akṣobhya Buddha is enshrined facing north as the Kvāḥpāḥdyaḥ (principal deity). An artistic woodentoraṇais placed above the main door, in the center of which a figure of Mahā-Akṣobhya with four heads and eight arms is carved. An inscription dated 1905 CE (NS 1126) is located on the base of the toraṇa. The first floor features a three-bayedpāsukā jhyālaalong with a small window on both the right and left sides. The upper floor contains an ordinary window, while the roof is covered with tin sheets. After thebāhāḥsustained damage from the earthquake of 2015 CE (VS 2072), the upper floor and roof were renovated with the assistance of the local community. In addition, a caitya (KAT2170-002) and aDharmadhātujinālayacaitya (KAT2170-003) are established in the courtyard of thebāhāḥ. An inscription, along with a statue of Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara, can also be seen affixed to the wall of the house situated on the western side of the courtyard.No direct inscription regarding the establishment of thisbāhāḥhas been found to date. Locke (1985, p. 358) mentions that there is a copper inscription at the front part of thebāhāḥwhich refers to it as "Khasā Chẽ Bāhāḥ," but he does not clarify the date inscribed on it. The record he mentioned is currently not available at thebāhāḥ. An inscription dated 1706 CE (NS 826) (KAT0760_I_001) related to the reign of King Bhāskara Malla has been found at Bhoṭe Bāhāḥ (KAT0760) in Kathmandu. According to this inscription, Siddhimuni Vajrācārya of Varṣacandra Mahāvihāra, which is a branch vihāra of Om Bāhāḥ, established Bhoṭe Bāhāḥ and arranged a land trust (kheta guṭhī) for its operation. Based on this, it becomes clear that thisbāhāḥwas already established before 1706 CE (NS 826).An inscription dated 1905 CE (NS 1026) is present on the lower part of the artistic woodentoraṇainstalled above the main door of thebāhāḥ. According to this inscription, it is known that Caityavara Siṃha, the son of Harṣamāna and grandson of Rudramāna Śākya, along with his family, offered the woodentoraṇa. However, Locke (1985, p. 358) has mentioned the date of thistoraṇaas NS 1024. In the map created by Pruscha (1975, p. 9), Guva Bāhāḥ is mentioned at the location of thisbāhāḥ.A daily morning worship had been conducted here since the past by the Śākya family, who are saṃgha members of Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ (KAT2190). However, due to various reasons following the devastating earthquake of 2015 CE (VS 2072), the daily worship has not been conducted regularly at thisbāhāḥ. For the past year, daily worship along with other religious and cultural activities have been completely halted here. During thebāhāḥpūjā, there is a tradition of circumambulating thisbāhāḥas well to pay homage to the Buddha (saṃgha member of Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ, Śākya, male, age 62).
description_ne: ओमबाहाल टोलमा अवस्थित यो बाहाः विश्वकर्मा (बिकमा) बाहाःको शाखा बाहाःको रूपमा रहेको छ, जसको स्थापना नेसं. ८२६ (सन् १७०६) भन्दा अघि भएको थाहा हुन्छ ।यो बाहाः ओमबाहाल टोलमा अवस्थित छ । यस बाहाःको पश्चिमतर्फ विश्वकर्मा बाहाः (KAT2190), अर्थात् बिकमा बाहाः, रहेको छ। यो बाहाः बिकमा बाहाःको शाखा बाहाः हो, जसमा बिकमा बाहाःको एउटा खलक समावेश रहेको छ (Locke 1985, p. 358) । यस बाहाःका विभिन्न नामहरू प्रचलनमा रहेका छन् । यसलाई वर्षचन्दन विहार पनि भनिन्छ। साथै Locke (1985, p. 358) ले यस बाहाःलाई खसा छेँ बाहाः तथा वं (ॐ) बाहाःका रूपमा उल्लेख गरेका छन् । यस बाहाःको द्यःछेँ तीनतले संरचनामा निर्माण गरिएको छ । भुइँतलामा अक्षोभ्य बुद्धलाई उत्तर दिशा फर्काई क्वाःपाःद्यःका रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । मूल ढोकामाथि कलात्मक काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ, जसको केन्द्रभागमा चारवटा टाउका र आठवटा हातयुक्त महाअक्षोभ्यको मूर्ति कुँदिएको छ । तोरणको पेटिकामा ने.सं. ११२६ (सन् १९०५) को अभिलेख रहेको छ । पहिलो तलामा तीन कवलयुक्त पासुका झ्याल तथा दायाँ–बायाँ एक–एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । माथिल्लो तलामा सामान्य झ्याल रहेको छ भने छाना जस्ता पाताले ढाकिएको छ। विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को भूकम्पबाट बाहाःमा क्षति पुगेपछि माथिल्लो तला र छानाको स्थानीय समुदायको सहयोगमा जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । यसका अतिरिक्त बाहाःको प्राङ्गणमा एउटा चैत्य (KAT2170-002) तथा धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य (KAT2170-003) स्थापना गरिएको छ । प्राङ्गणको पश्चिमपट्टि अवस्थित घरको भित्तामा पद्मपाणि लोकेश्वरको मूर्तिसहित एउटा अभिलेख पनि टाँसिएको देख्न सकिन्छ ।यस बाहाःको स्थापना सम्बन्धी कुनै प्रत्यक्ष अभिलेख हालसम्म प्राप्त भएको छैन । Locke (1985, p. 358) ले बाहाःको अगाडिको भागमा तामाको अभिलेख रहेको र उक्त अभिलेखमा यस बाहाःलाई “खसा छेँ बाहाः” भनिएको उल्लेख गरेका छन्, तर उनले सो अभिलेख कुँदिएको मिति स्पष्ट पारेका छैनन् । उनले उल्लेख गरेको उक्त अभिलेख हाल बाहाःमा उपलब्ध छैन । काठमाडौंको भोटे बाहाः (KAT0760)मा राजा भाष्कर मल्लको राज्यकालसँग सम्बन्धित नेसं. ८२६ (सन् १७०६) को अभिलेख (KAT0760_I_001) प्राप्त भएको छ । सो अभिलेखअनुसार ओम् बाहाःको शाखा विहारका रूपमा रहेको वर्षचन्द्र महाविहारका सिद्धिमुनि वज्राचार्यले भोटे बाहाःको स्थापना गरी बाहाः सञ्चालनका लागि खेत गुठी व्यवस्था गरिदिएको विवरण उल्लेख गरिएको छ । यस आधारमा यो बाहाः ने.सं. ८२६ (सन् १७०६) भन्दा अगाडि नै स्थापना भइसकेको स्पष्ट हुन्छ ।बाहाःको मूल ढोकामाथि स्थापित कलात्मक काष्ठतोरणको तल्लो भागमा नेसं. १०२६ (सन् १९०५) को अभिलेख रहेको छ। उक्त अभिलेखअनुसार रुद्रमान शाक्यका नाति हर्षमानका छोरा चैत्यवर सिंह तथा उनको परिवारले उक्त काष्ठतोरण चढाएको जानकारी प्राप्त हुन्छ । यद्यपि Locke (1985, p. 358) ले सो तोरणको मिति नेसं. १०२४ भनी उल्लेख गरेका छन् । Pruscha (1975, p. 9) ले बनाएको नक्शामा यस बाहाःको स्थानमा गुव बाहाः उल्लेख गरेका छन् ।यहाँ विश्वकर्मा बाहाः (KAT2190) का संघ सदस्य शाक्य परिवारद्वारा विगतदेखि नै दैनिक बिहान नित्यपूजा सञ्चालन हुँदै आएको थियो । तर विसं. २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को विनाशकारी भूकम्पपछिका विभिन्न कारणले यस बाहाःमा नित्यपूजा नियमित रूपमा सञ्चालन हुन सकेको छैन । पछिल्लो एक वर्षयता यहाँ नित्यपूजासहित अन्य धार्मिक तथा सांस्कृतिक गतिविधिहरू पूर्ण रूपमा बन्द रहेका छन् । बाहाःपूजाको क्रममा यस बाहाःमा पनि परिक्रमा गरी बुद्धको दर्शन गर्ने चलन रहेको छ (saṃgha member of Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ, Śākya, male, age 62)।

historical_events.event_description: A statue of Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara is established on the wall of the house situated on the western side of thisbāhāḥ. An inscription containing details of the statue's installation is carved on its pedestal. Although the remaining text is unreadable due to the letters having worn away, the installation date "Samvat 901" is clearly visible.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of Mañjuśrī Vihāra (Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ KAT2190)
historical_events.event_description: This inscription is affixed to the wall of the house situated on the western side of thisbāhāḥ. According to the details mentioned within, it does not pertain to thisbāhāḥbut rather concerns the renovation of the nearby Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ, located to its west. Motikāji, the son of Caitavarasiṃ of Kathmandu, carried out the renovation of Viśvakarmā Bāhāḥ.

From the inscription located at the base of the main door, it is known that Caityavara Siṃha, the son of Harṣamāna and grandson of Rudramāna Śākya, along with his family, offered the woodentoraṇa. Locke (1985, p. 358) has mentioned the date of this inscription as NS 1024, whereas it is actually inscribed as 1905 CE (NS 1026)

An inscription is carved on acaitya(KAT2170-002) located in the courtyard of thebāhāḥ; however, because the letters have worn away and become illegible, the specific details contained within are unknown. Since inscriptions of this type primarily document the establishment of thecaitya, it can be assumed that this inscription also contains details regarding thecaitya's installation.
